title: Showroom sections sent as a JSON array are saved in a format the site cannot read
location: backend/routes/showrooms.ts:251-300 (stores the value in TEXT via createRecord)
steps: POST /api/showrooms with status published and sections as a JSON array (not a string) -> 201.
Stored value is a PostgreSQL array literal {"{...}","{...}"}; the public page shows only the fallback "Get in Touch".
expected: Arrays are serialised to JSON before saving, or rejected.
actual: Validation passes, storage corrupts the sections. The web builder sends JSON strings, so current users are not affected.
impact: Latent data corruption for any other API client (future mobile app, scripts).
fix: In POST/PUT normalise sections with JSON.stringify(normalizeSections(value)) before saving.
